title: What to expect from Team Accounts and Roles

question.author: member_284
question.body: I am checking my CloudBox setup. Which documented details matter for team accounts and roles?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Team Accounts documentation says: Guests are external people with limited access to specific folders only. Every role is tied to a named user account; shared accounts are not supported. Business and Enterprise plans include team accounts with three roles. Admins manage membership, billing, and security settings. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
